text:
Ivy: Street night market + pizza slice crawl + boardgames in the lounge Friday evening? thinking 6:30 slices then games at 8. market's cash-only for some vendors. :pizza: :joystick:
Noel: love this. market near Pier 9 or uptown? Pier is closer to me.
Renee: pier works. also heads-up: stroller-friendly (bringing my partner + baby).
Omar: count me in. can we keep it low-key? 3-4 games max, nothing loud.
Talia: i'm in. prefer early start 6:15 if that helps vendors.
Ivy: ok 6:15 meet at lobby, walk together. quick poll for whether people need cash or can Venmo?
EventBot: Poll created: "Bring cash or Venmo?" Options: Cash only, Venmo ok, I can cover others. Link: https://events.example/polls/pm204
Noel: i can Venmo but will bring $20 cash just in case.
Renee: bringing stroller, FYI. also allergic to sesame, will avoid vendors that use tahini.
Omar: noted re: sesame. maybe pick places that label allergens.
Talia: i'll pack a small folding table for games in case lounge tables are busy.
Ivy: great. budget target $15-25 depending on slices and drinks. Karaoke not this time, promise. :sweat_smile:
Noel: which games? light ones—Coup, Sushi Go, Love Letter?
Omar: i've got Coup + Hanabi. low setup.
Renee: i'll bring Sushi Go (too on the nose?).
Talia: i'll bring a small speaker and Fairy Lights for the lounge table. low volume.
Ivy: perfect. can someone add to calendar and include stroller note & cash heads-up?
Noel: i'll make the calendar event and add vendor map. link: https://calendar.example/event/night-market-pizza
Renee: RSVP yes + one (partner + baby). will we reserve a spot in lounge or first-come?
Ivy: lounge isn't reservable after 7:30. we'll aim to grab space by 8; if crowded we can fallback to the rooftop terrace.
Omar: rides? I'll drive 3 people, leaving at 6:00 from Westgate.
Talia: can you pick me up near Westgate?
Omar: yep DM me the address.
EventBot: Reminder set: "Night market pizza & games" Fri 18:15 lobby meetup.
Ivy: thank you all! see you Friday  bring cash, comfy shoes, and game faces. :sparkles:
